title: pages
description: Consumer contract for Delta table stage2_page_analysis, written by Stage 2 page analysis. Not a medallion gold table and not a new directory name. Consumers must ignore unknown properties.

url_hash.description: Hash of the canonical URL. Upsert key for this table.

title.description: Document title, or a placeholder such as Untitled, Error, or PDF Document.

is_massive_doc.description: True when the page was routed toward Stage 4 as a large document.

text_content.description: Extracted text, truncated by the Stage 2 writer. Empty when the page is low quality or an error.

has_error.description: True on the error-record path. Those rows are quarantined to stage2_errors and are not the silver analysis set.

error_message.description: Present on the error-record path only.

error_code.description: HTTP or sentinel code on the error-record path only.

processed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp from the writer (datetime.isoformat). src/core/schemas.py still declares timestamp(ms); LakehouseManager does not apply that declaration on write and infers the column from the batch.

domain.description: Partition column. LakehouseManager sets the public-suffix registrable domain of url. Not a writer field. Rows with no usable host go to domain_quarantine instead of this table.
